impact.subtitle: Pick a component, pick a condition, run the model. Propagation honours redundancy groups and shared services.
impact.explorer.search: Search by name, type or layer
impact.condition.mixed: Conditions that apply to all {count} selected components
impact.condition.pickFirst: Select a component to see the conditions that apply to it: failure, degradation, power, links, certificates, warranty, subscription, end of life, exploited vulnerability, capacity and maintenance windows.
impact.condition.none: No single condition applies to every selected component. Narrow the selection.
impact.condition.degraded.label: Degraded
impact.condition.degraded.desc: Still serving, below its SLO; dependants degrade, redundancy holds.
impact.condition.failed.label: Failed
impact.condition.failed.desc: Unreachable; every dependant without redundancy goes down.
impact.condition.power_loss.label: Power loss
impact.condition.power_loss.desc: Both feeds lost; everything mounted, powered or cooled by it fails.
impact.condition.link_down.label: Link down
impact.condition.link_down.desc: The circuit or port drops; traffic re-routes only where a second path exists.
impact.condition.certificate_expired.des: TLS handshakes fail for every client that pins or validates it.
impact.condition.warranty_expired.label: Warranty expired
impact.condition.warranty_expired.desc: Hardware without vendor support; the services on it move to at risk.
impact.condition.subscription_expired.de: Licence or tenant lapses; seats and API calls are refused at renewal.
impact.condition.end_of_life.label: End of life
impact.condition.end_of_life.desc: No more patches; exposure grows for everything running on it.
impact.condition.vulnerability_exploited: A known CVE is used; the component and its peers degrade under containment.
impact.condition.capacity_exhausted.desc: Addresses, IOPS, power or seats run out; new demand is refused.
impact.condition.maintenance.label: Maintenance window
impact.condition.maintenance.desc: Taken out of service on purpose; dependants degrade for the window, redundancy holds.
impact.result.idleBody: Choose at least one component and a condition, then run the model.
impact.result.narrative: {components} under “{condition}”: {down} services predicted down, {degraded} degraded, {users} users and {revenue} per hour at risk.
impact.result.noServices: No business service is affected by this scenario.
impact.assistant.idle: Suggestions appear after a run. They reference only CIs and relationships that exist in the graph, and each one names the evidence it is based on.
impact.assistant.question: Scenario: {components} under the condition “{condition}”. The model predicts {down} services down and {degraded} degraded. What should the on-call team do first, and which other services share the same root cause?
impact.saved.empty: No saved scenarios yet. Running a model saves its scenario.
services.subtitle: Every business service with its propagated health, root causes, SLA target and error budget; open incidents beside them.
services.empty: No business services have been modelled yet.
services.incidents.title: Open incidents
services.incidents.subtitle: Alerts correlated into incidents by the BSM engine
services.incidents.ackError: The incident could not be acknowledged.

discovery.sweep.label: Sweep progress
discovery.nodes.title: Discovery Nodes
discovery.nodes.subtitle: mTLS-enrolled collectors reporting heartbeats
discovery.nodes.empty: No Node has enrolled yet. Install one per site and register it with an enrolment token.
discovery.nodes.noCollectors: No collector has run on this Node yet
discovery.jobs.title: Recent jobs
discovery.jobs.subtitle: Latest {count} jobs across every Node
discovery.jobs.empty: No jobs have been scheduled yet.
auth.signInDescription: Your organisation's identity provider verifies who you are; OpenMap then shows the estate your tenant and roles allow.
auth.securedBy: Single sign-on through your organisation's identity provider
auth.reason.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth.reason.rejected: The API no longer accepts your session. Sign in again to continue.
auth.reason.unavailable: The identity provider could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
auth.reason.misconfigured: Sign-in is not configured for this deployment. Contact your administrator.
auth.callback.done: Signed in. Returning you to the console.
auth.callback.denied: Sign-in was cancelled or declined by the identity provider.
auth.callback.stateMismatch: This sign-in response does not match the request this browser started. Start again.
auth.callback.missingCode: The identity provider returned no authorization code. Start again.
auth.callback.nonceMismatch: The identity token does not belong to this sign-in request. Start again.
auth.callback.exchangeFailed: The authorization code could not be exchanged for a session. Start again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Who you are, where you are signed in, and the record of every change made in this tenant.
settings.identity.title: Your session
settings.audit.title: Audit log
settings.audit.subtitle: Every mutation, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
settings.audit.subject: Subject
settings.audit.empty: No changes have been recorded yet.
settings.tenant.title: Tenant settings
settings.tenant.subtitle: Defaults every user of this tenant inherits. Only administrators can change them.
settings.tenant.readOnly: You can view these settings; an administrator can change them.
settings.tenant.outboundIntegrationsEnab: Outbound integrations may call external systems
settings.tenant.error: The settings could not be saved.
assets.title: Assets
assets.subtitle: Every piece of hardware the estate owns: where it is in its life, what is about to lose cover, and the plans that bring new infrastructure in.
assets.attention.title: Needs attention
assets.attention.subtitle: Warranty, vendor support or end-of-support dates inside the horizon, soonest first.
assets.attention.empty: Nothing loses cover inside this horizon.
assets.register.title: Asset register
assets.register.subtitle: Tracked hardware with its stage; operators move assets between stages.
assets.register.empty: No assets yet. Create a plan below to start tracking planned hardware, or let the warranty integrations populate records from discovered serial numbers.
assets.plans.title: Infrastructure plans
assets.plans.subtitle: Planned infrastructure with its bill of materials; each line creates planned assets that move to in stock and deployed as they arrive.
assets.plans.readOnly: Operators and administrators create plans and change their status.
assets.plans.name: Name
assets.plans.error: The plan could not be created.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Where OpenMap talks to the rest of the estate: ITSM, SIEM, monitoring, notifications, warranty and identity systems, each with its health and deliveries.
integrations.catalogue.title: Catalogue
integrations.catalogue.subtitle: Categories the single release ships adapters for; pick one to filter the configured integrations.
integrations.list.title: Configured integrations
integrations.list.subtitle: Health follows the last probe or delivery; counts are the last hour.
integrations.list.empty: No integrations configured in this category yet.
integrations.table.name: Name
integrations.detail.title: Integration detail
integrations.detail.pick: Select an integration to see its configuration, mappings and deliveries.
integrations.detail.readOnly: Operators and administrators can inspect integration details.
integrations.testFailed: The probe could not be run.
integrations.saveFailed: The integration could not be saved.
integrations.form.endpointHint: Base URL of the remote system.
integrations.form.credentialHint: OpenBao path holding the credential; secrets never pass through the console.
integrations.form.eventsHint: Hold Ctrl or Cmd to pick several.
integrations.deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
ipam.title: IP address management
ipam.subtitle: Subnets by containment with utilisation, the addresses inside them, DNS zones and records, DHCP scopes and leases, all as discovered.
ipam.tree.title: Subnet tree
ipam.tree.subtitle: Supernets contain the subnets inside them; utilisation counts stored addresses against usable hosts.
ipam.subnet.title: Subnet
ipam.subnet.pick: Select a subnet to see its addresses and the next free one.
ipam.addresses.title: Addresses · {count}
ipam.addresses.empty: No addresses recorded in this subnet.
ipam.dns.title: DNS
ipam.dns.subtitle: Zones and records from the DNS collectors (zone transfers and server APIs).
ipam.dhcp.title: DHCP
ipam.dhcp.subtitle: Scopes and current leases from the DHCP collectors (Windows, ISC, Kea).
dcim.title: Data centre infrastructure
dcim.subtitle: Rooms, racks, what sits in them and what powers them, drawn from the placements and PDU readings the collectors report.
dcim.heatmap.title: Room heat map
dcim.heatmap.subtitle: One tile per rack, coloured by power draw against rating (occupancy when no PDU reports). Select a tile for its elevation.
dcim.elevation.title: Rack elevation
dcim.devices.title: Mounted devices · {count}
dcim.devices.empty: Nothing is mounted in this rack.
dcim.power.title: Power feeds
dcim.power.empty: No PDU or feed powers this rack.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Apache Superset dashboards over the time-travel warehouse, embedded with your tenant's row-level security.
analytics.unavailable: Superset is not reachable or has refused the embed; the rest of the console is unaffected.
analytics.embedFailed: The dashboard could not be embedded: {reason}
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask about the estate in plain words. Every answer shows the read-only query it ran, so you can check it.
assistant.empty: Nothing asked yet. Try one of these or type your own question.
assistant.placeholder: Which business services depend on hosts in rack RYD-DH01-A-01?
assistant.hint: Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line.
assistant.example.hosts: How many hosts run each operating system?
assistant.example.services: Which business services are degraded right now?
assistant.example.subnets: Which subnets hold the most IP addresses?
assistant.example.power: Which PDUs power the most hosts?
software.title: Software and licences
software.subtitle: Every software product discovered across the estate with its footprint, its licence position and the vulnerabilities open against it.
software.filter.text: Search software by vendor, name or version
software.catalogue.title: Software catalogue
software.catalogue.subtitle: Products discovered on hosts, with where they run and what covers them.
software.posture.title: Licence posture
software.posture.subtitle: Licences that need a decision: consumed beyond entitlement, expiring within {days} days, or already expired.
software.posture.empty: Every licence is within entitlement and in date.
vulnerabilities.title: Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.subtitle: CVEs correlated to installed software, ranked by CVSS, with the hosts and business services each one puts at risk.
vulnerabilities.list.title: Open vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.list.subtitle: Highest CVSS first; select a CVE to see its blast radius.
vulnerabilities.detail.title: Blast radius
vulnerabilities.detail.pick: Select a CVE to see the software, hosts and business services it reaches.
vulnerabilities.detail.noServices: No business service depends on the affected hosts.
vulnerabilities.detail.truncated: Only the first {count} hosts were walked for business services.
dependencies.layout.label: Layout
dependencies.layout.forceUnavailable: The force layout is offered up to {count} nodes; larger maps stay in lanes.
dependencies.isolate.active: Blast radius of {name}: {count} nodes lit, the rest dimmed
cmdb.detail.code.label: Short code
cmdb.detail.code.hint: A layer prefix, a dash and a slug of letters, digits and dashes; unique across this tenant.
cmdb.detail.code.error: The code was not saved: it is malformed or already names another item.
discovery.scopes.title: Discovery scopes
discovery.scopes.subtitle: Every subnet the sweep plans against, with the addresses it must never touch, the credential set it uses and the rate it may run at.
discovery.scopes.empty: No subnets yet. Import or discover a subnet and it appears here as a scope.
discovery.scopes.exclusionsHint: One IPv4 CIDR per line, for example 10.0.3.0/24; the planner never schedules these addresses.
discovery.scopes.credentialHint: OpenBao path the Node resolves at run time; the secret itself never leaves the vault.
discovery.scopes.error: The scope was not saved: check that every exclusion is an IPv4 CIDR and the limits are positive.
discovery.scopes.anySite: Any site with an online Node
setup.title: Initial setup
setup.subtitle: Six steps from an empty OpenMap to a living digital twin: organization, sites, connectivity, Discovery Nodes and credentials, integrations, generate.
setup.readOnly: Only administrators can change the setup; the steps below show what was configured.
setup.steps.label: Setup steps
setup.org.title: Organization and business units
setup.org.subtitle: The root of the digital twin. Each business unit is a tenant with its own scoped view.
setup.org.name: Organization name
setup.org.airGapped: Air-gapped deployment: no outbound call at runtime
setup.org.units.hint: The unit you are signed in to is listed first. A new unit becomes a tenant; its users get the tenant claim in the identity provider.
setup.org.unit.name: Business unit name
setup.sites.title: Sites
setup.sites.subtitle: Data centres, colocations, offices, branches, cloud regions and edge sites. Saving a site creates its CI in the CMDB.
setup.sites.empty: No site yet. Add the first one below.
setup.sites.column.name: Name
setup.sites.form.title: New site
setup.sites.codeHint: Short upper-case code used in CI names and Node ids, e.g. RYD. It cannot change later.
setup.sites.name: Name
setup.links.title: Inter-site connectivity
setup.links.subtitle: WAN links between sites become site_link CIs connected to both ends, so an outage is traced to its circuit.
setup.links.empty: No link yet. With a single site this step can be skipped.
setup.nodes.title: Discovery Nodes
setup.nodes.subtitle: One Node per site runs the collectors. Register it here, enrol it on the host with the one-time token, then store credential sets and the subnets to sweep.
setup.nodes.nodeIdHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, e.g. node-ryd-01
setup.nodes.registered: Node {node} registered for {site}. The token below is shown once; registering the same id again issues a new one.
setup.nodes.install: On the host, with the Node binary installed, run:
setup.nodes.cloudHint: Cloud regions need no Node of their own: cloud collectors run from any enrolled Node.
setup.credentials.title: Credential sets
setup.credentials.subtitle: Stored in OpenBao under the reference. OpenMap keeps the reference only and never shows a value again.
setup.scopes.title: Discovery scopes
setup.scopes.subtitle: Subnets to sweep, each housed at a site. They become subnet CIs and the planner turns them into jobs for the site's Node.
setup.integrations.title: Integrations and seed imports
setup.integrations.subtitle: Optional. ITSM, monitoring, warranty and identity systems: inbound ones seed the twin, outbound ones receive its events. They can be added later from the Integrations screen.
setup.generate.title: Generate the digital twin
setup.generate.subtitle: Creates the CIs the twin still lacks, records the generation and starts the first discovery sweep.
setup.generate.noNodes: No Node is online yet: the sweep is planned and starts when a Node at the site enrols and pulls its jobs.
dashboard.setup.title: Finish the initial setup
dashboard.setup.body: Sites, Discovery Nodes, credentials and scopes come first; the digital twin is generated at the end.

dashboard.wizard.shared: Share with everyone in this tenant
